theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_rmp_infinity_place
theorems.statement: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K], ∃ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K (FractionRing (Polynomial K)), algebraMap (Polynomial K) (FractionRing (Polynomial K)) Polynomial.X ∉ v.toValuationSubring ∧ v.deg = 1 ∧ (∀ a : Polynomial K, a ≠ 0 → v.ord (algebraMap (Polynomial K) (FractionRing (Polynomial K)) a) = -(a.natDegree : ℤ)) ∧ (∀ w : AlgebraicCurve.Place K (FractionRing (Polynomial K)), algebraMap (Polynomial K) (FractionRing (Polynomial K)) Polynomial.X ∉ w.toValuationSubring → w = v)
theorems.natural_summary: Combines accepted reciprocal-presentation, finite-place, polynomial-order and valuation-characterization lemmas to construct and uniquely characterize the place at infinity.
